description: Two commands that make the global config directory and write a minimal opencode.json with only the schema key.

steps.description: This creates the global config file, so every project inherits a working model. `opencode.json` holds the model you talk to, the permissions, the extra files, the plugins, and the tool servers.
`mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode` makes the global config directory, and `-p` keeps it quiet if the directory already exists.
`cat > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json <<'JSON'` writes the file from the heredoc that follows. The quoted delimiter keeps the contents literal.
The JSON body holds one key, `$schema`. The page says it is optional and worth keeping, because it tells an editor what keys are legal.

title: Creating the Global opencode.json
